notes.title: v0.51.8 Release
notes.notes:
The default game version has been updated to v0.51.6-beta-hotfix-1 to v0.51.8, which includes all the changes and additions between those versions. This fixes a lot of long-standing bugs, enhances the default control configurations, and improves performance on portable systems like laptops and Steam Deck. Steam Deck performance in general still has a ways to go, but for now there are only a few minor enhancements to consider before adding additional content!

 What's Changed
🎁 New Content
* Native Mac release!
* Native Linux/Steam Deck release!
✨ Enhancements
* Updated core NW.js libraries to speed up the above
* ALL maps have been reworked for better performance!
* GitHub releases will now have builds attached
* Releases will now also appear at https://flashdim.itch.io/kins-chronicle
🪲🔨 Bug Fixes
* Quitting to title then loading a game locked camera position (2nd attempt at fix)
* 3d flicker/flash during intro
* Gamepad and on-screen controls have been reworked
* Inconsistent wandering mob sizes by @flashdim in https://github.com/flashdim/kins-chronicle/pull/164
* Observer tarot animation plays incorrectly by @flashdim in https://github.com/flashdim/kins-chronicle/pull/167
* Loot pots opening glitches by @flashdim in https://github.com/flashdim/kins-chronicle/pull/171
* Help button doesn't trigger menu on battle screen #168 by @flashdim in https://github.com/flashdim/kins-chronicle/pull/172
* Bosses/Enemies give alert (!) gabs after defeat #163 by @flashdim in https://github.com/flashdim/kins-chronicle/pull/173
Full Changelog: https://github.com/flashdim/kins-chronicle/compare/v0.51.6-beta-hotfix-1...v0.51.8-beta

notes.title: Early Access v0.42 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Getting back into it! Happy Halloween, everyone! This update finalizes the list of weapons and armor! Weird, right? :D

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40528645/bfff785eaa171f21f35e72a032e57a62c18bde9d.jpg

Newly added are Scythes, Katanas, and Claws! 
Not only that, but ALL weapons now have special Feats that have a 20% chance to trigger ANY time you attack. So, if a character doesn't have a good spell option or is out of MP, just attacking still has a good chance to turn the tide of battle!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40528645/f26e45b624e1202382d2570fe55010cd8824feff.jpg

Staves are a little different in this regard - their Feat is linked to the elemental type and power of the Staff. Check those out. ;)

New Features
 Added Scythe weapons, icons, animations, crafting, and Reap Feat
 Added Katana weapons, icons, animations, crafting, and Debilitate Feat
 Added Claw weapons, icons, animations, crafting, and Rend Feat
 Added Shield Armor, icons, and crafting
 New Bows Weapon Feat: Arrow Rain
 New Swords Weapon Feat: Sword Trip
 New Axe Weapon Feat: Armor Breach
 New Spears Weapon Feat: Skewer
 New Staves Weapon Feat: Spell Casting


Enhancements
 Changed "Usable" in Items menu to "Items", and "Special" to "Unique"
 Removed "Power" listing from Items menu to fit all categories better
 Zero's default/usable weapons changed from Swords/Axe to Claws/Axe
 Decreased Petrifying Scream targets from 4 to 2


Fixes
 Changed Stun to only effect an enemy/ally for a single turn to prevent "stun lock"

notes.title: v0.35 Beta/Demo Update
notes.notes:
We have our giveaway winners!
@LumineraGame, @hpl2016,  @Olmos_1,  @DeadeGuard98, and @supherbyus all win keys for the beta and final releases of Kin's Chronicle!
In addition, @Willsama974 got to customize the new Boss, Rogon!

notes.title: v0.29 Demo Update
notes.notes:
Thanks to everyone who has checked out the demo so far! It will be updated for a short while with minor improvements and a little bit more content before I start working on the Beta version of the game. The Demo will stay available on and through launch!

New Features
Added optional on-screen controls
You can toggle the buttons using the eye icon next to them!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40528645/1e9e05acfa45a321c2bce59fd942aa937f28a088.png

New Quick Access Buttons
The photo will take a screenshot for you, and the book will quicksave the game (also F5)! You can change the side of the screen these appear on in the Options menu.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40528645/c4de7723c1b75782e3d6a313be7b479b3d7be9ac.png

Enhancements
Empty Chests now fade and disappear
No need to feel let down when you see a chest in the distance, only to see you already opened it.

Increased FOV Default by 10%
This should help prevent the "zoomed in" feeling when speaking to characters. You can always increase it further in the Options menu, as well.

Other Fixes
Fixed intro spell effects causing the canyon walls to flicker
Fixed Dry Basin entrance glowing through the terrain in Bramble Gorge
